title: Default access, guardrails & --unsafe-recurse
objective: Default agent to opencode (with internet), strictly prohibit edits inside little-mester repo by default, introduce --unsafe-recurse for deliberate self-modification. All tasks verified complete and implemented in lab script: UNSAFE_RECURSE=0 default with guard at check_workspace line 70; --unsafe-recurse flag at line 190 lifts guard with confirmation; AGENT defaults to opencode; egress enabled by default via [egress, internal] network mode.

acceptance_criteria.text: The default agent is opencode and egress is enabled by default.
